rationale: Both candidates independently converge on the same core issues the real reviewers raised (cudagraph_mode-in-modeling design concern, seed reproducibility failure under full cudagraphs, NPU compilation_config gap, stale yaml comments, duplicate pooler-flag assignment), and X's proposed code-level fixes are somewhat more concrete/actionable. But Y is more rigorously grounded — it explicitly tags each claim as verified/refuted against the PR-time tree, correctly recognizes that the cudagraph_mode-in-modeling concern was already resolved via the in-code TODO (avoiding a redundant flag), and additionally catches three stale docs referencing the old max_num_seqs=10 default plus CI-lane-to-file mapping and benchmark-arithmetic verification that map onto the actual benchmark-request threads in the ground truth — points X misses entirely. X's report also leans on a few more speculative/tangential claims (e.g. comparing to an unrelated fish_speech model file) that dent precision slightly.
